population: Historical Ethereum successful plain value transfers to non-precompile EOAs; narrow execution controls, not general legitimate-contract population
selection: Ascending listed block, canonical transaction index; first eligible identities with distinct sender and recipient, at most four per block; stop at 32 or exhaustion. No model or detector outputs enter selection.
eligibility: Unique transaction hash; canonical transaction and receipt share block hash and chain identity
Positive value, empty input, destination exists and is not precompile (integer address > 65535)
Destination code is 0x at both parent and inclusion block; sender code 0x at parent block
Sender and recipient each not previously admitted in this control study
acquisition: Read-only MeteredRPC through shared $10 ledger; maximum 512 upstream logical requests; SHA-256 pinned raw responses; no synthetic trace or zero-default state
analysis: Actual production Stage 1 and ranker only when authenticated call trace exists; incomplete coverage stays incomplete. General benign detection, full-system F1 and paired billed latency require their own complete production observations.
metrics: Eligibility pass count and per-row rejection reason
Actual Stage 1 verdict frequencies and BENIGN-skip eligibility fraction on captured controls
Observed execution wall time with explicit stage scope; never substitute for paired inference cost saving
isolation: Separate control population; no held-out exploit file loading, no final-exam dispatch, no threshold changes
limitations: EOA transfers cannot establish benign smart-contract false-positive rates
32 intended controls cannot replicate the paper 1000-row population
Transaction execution benign by the user-authorized construction; no claim that sender has never been involved in an incident
